hooks.command:
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c 'import sys, os, json, datetime
ev = sys.argv[1]
raw = sys.stdin.read()
def emit():
    sys.stdout.write("{\"decision\":\"allow\"}\n" if ev == "PreToolUse" else "{}\n")
try:
    p = json.loads(raw)
    ws = (p.get("workspacePaths") or [None])[0]
    if ws and os.path.isdir(ws):
        d = os.path.join(ws, ".project", "telemetry")
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
        ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        # Canonical envelope: ts, harness, event, session (= agy conversationId).
        rec = {"ts": ts, "harness": "antigravity", "event": ev,
               "session": p.get("conversationId")}
        if ev in ("PreInvocation", "PostInvocation"):
            # Model observed serving this invocation -> shared canonical routing
            # stream. Observational (event=model_invocation), NOT a praxis tier
            # decision; the harness field partitions it from claude-code/codex
            # decision rows, which the report scripts filter on.
            rec["event"] = "model_invocation"
            rec["phase"] = "pre" if ev == "PreInvocation" else "post"
            rec["model"] = p.get("modelName")
            rec["invocationNum"] = p.get("invocationNum")
            rec["initialNumSteps"] = p.get("initialNumSteps")
            stream = "model-routing.jsonl"
        elif ev in ("PreToolUse", "PostToolUse"):
            # Raw agy tool audit has no cross-harness equivalent (claude/codex
            # tool activity lives in the factory-metrics markdown store), so it
            # stays in an agy-scoped stream rather than corrupting agent-spawns.
            tc = p.get("toolCall") or {}
            a = tc.get("args") or {}
            rec["model"] = p.get("modelName")
            rec["stepIdx"] = p.get("stepIdx")
            rec["tool"] = tc.get("name")
            rec["toolSummary"] = a.get("toolSummary")
            rec["error"] = p.get("error") or None
            stream = "antigravity-activity.jsonl"
        else:
            # Stop -> shared canonical session stream.
            rec["event"] = "session_stop"
            rec["executionNum"] = p.get("executionNum")
            rec["terminationReason"] = p.get("terminationReason")
            rec["fullyIdle"] = p.get("fullyIdle")
            rec["error"] = p.get("error") or None
            stream = "sessions.jsonl"
        with open(os.path.join(d, stream), "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
except Exception:
    pass
emit()' PreToolUse || printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'
